about.title: About Shree Mahakaleshwar Salasar Hanuman Sewa Trust
about.description: Shree Mahakaleshwar Salasar Hanuman Sewa Trust (SMSHST) is a spiritual and social trust founded with the vision of uniting faith and seva (service). With the blessings of Mahakal Baba (Ujjain) and Salasar Balaji Maharaj (Rajasthan), we are on a sacred journey to build a grand Mahadham in Surat by 2029. Our mission is to preserve Sanatan values, spread seva, and create a spiritual legacy for future generations.

descriptions: It is believed that Lord Mahakal is the Mahakaal of all Kaal (the destroyer of time itself)
It is believed that the darshan of Salasar Hanuman Balaji frees one from all sorrows.

bhudaan.title: Bhumi Daan
bhudaan.lead:
In Sanatan Dharma, three forms of donation are considered the most sacred: Kanya Daan, Anna Daan, and Bhumi Daan.

And among these, the donation of land for the creation of a Mahadham stands as the highest virtue. When you offer land for this divine cause, you are not just giving soil, you are laying the foundation of faith, service, and Sanatan culture for generations to come.
bhudaan.subtitle: Donate Land for the construction of the Grand Mahadham.

about.heading: About SMSH & The Mahadham Vision
about.lead: Shree Mahakaleshwar Salasar Hanuman Sewa Trust (SMSHST) is building a grand Mahadham in Surat by 2029 – a spiritual landmark that will be more than a temple.
about.whyDescription: Surat is not only a city of enterprise but also of deep-rooted faith. With devotees and trustees coming together from across India, Surat was chosen as the home of the Mahadham – a sacred space for devotion, service, and cultural revival.

testimonials.message: Mahadham is not just a temple, but a living symbol of faith and service. Every effort takes us closer to 2029.

testimonials.message: Contributing to Mahadham is not just a donation, it is an offering of faith. I feel blessed to be part of this divine mission.

testimonials.name: Trustee, SMSHST
testimonials.message: Every brick of Mahadham will carry the blessings of countless devotees. Together, we are building faith for generations.

testimonials.name: Trustee, SMSHST
testimonials.message: Mahadham will not only be a temple, it will be a place of seva, culture, and unity. That is why I contribute with devotion.

testimonials.name: Devotee, SMSHST
testimonials.message: When I think of Mahadham, I see a future where every devotee feels at home, embraced by faith and service.

testimonials.message: The vision of 2029 is not just about completing a temple, but about creating a living symbol of Sanatan Dharma.

testimonials.name: Devotee, SMSHST
testimonials.message: My children will one day say — our family helped build this Mahadham. That is my true pride.

testimonials.name: Trustee, SMSHST
testimonials.message: Land, wealth, time — whatever we give for Mahadham, it all becomes eternal seva.

testimonials.name: Trustee, SMSHST

aboutTeam.heading: Team at the Temple
aboutTeam.description: At Shree Mahakaleshwar Salasar Hanuman Sewa Trust, our true strength lies in the dedication of our spiritual leaders, trustees, and volunteers.
